Cryptography

ऑडिट लॉगिंग

The process of recording security-related events, operations, or accesses within a cryptographic or PKI environment to provide accountability, traceability, and forensics.

Definition

The process of recording security-related events, operations, or accesses within a cryptographic or PKI environment to provide accountability, traceability, and forensics.

Operational example

Audit logging of all key management operations ensures that any unauthorized access or anomaly is detectable and traceable for investigation.
